name: smwmusic-stunt-race-fx-goal
title: Stunt Race FX - Goal
description:
The Goal theme from Stunt Race FX, which is technically 2 seperate songs combined into 1.

There are 2 defines in the Part 1 and Combined text file, a define which adds the vanilla SMW Goal sound (#define goal),
and a define that combines both halves of the song into 1 (#define loop).
The 2nd half of the song is also included as an entirely seperate song like in the original game.

Incompatibile with Global use due to using Echo and samples.

Credit goes to KungFuFurby for providing an SPC Dump of the 2nd half.

Requested by Humberto Quackenbush
